name: clojure-lsp

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

smoke:
mkdir -p "$HOME/cljproject/src"; printf '(ns demo)
(defn add [a b] (+ a b))
' > "$HOME/cljproject/src/demo.clj"; printf '{:paths ["src"]}
' > "$HOME/cljproject/deps.edn"; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/clojure-lsp" format --project-root "$HOME/cljproject" --filenames "$HOME/cljproject/src/demo.clj" --settings '{:project-specs [] :source-paths ["src"] :auto-add-ns-to-new-files? false}'; grep -q defn "$HOME/cljproject/src/demo.clj"
notes: Native LSP CLI with local file-formatting smoke test; project dependency resolution and language-server editor integration are outside this bundle.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
